_comment: Fabricated. A service crash-loops on OOMKilled because a 512 MB cache sits inside a 256 Mi memory limit (the same incident as component 01's skeleton). Scores are what a model would assign. root_cause is NOT a rubric criterion: it records whether the option addresses the evidence, and is used only by --stress.

candidates.title: Raise the memory limit in the existing app role
Cap the cache below the limit via a new task file
Move the cache to a sidecar with its own limit
